label: prop:depth-2-identification-bloch-suslin
title: Depth-2 identification of $G^{(2)}(\mathcal{H}_q)$ with $K_3^{\mathrm{ind}}(F) \otimes \mathbb{Q}$ — provable via Bloch--Suslin
html:
Let F be a number field, q \in F generic, and let \mathcal{H}_q be the substrate convolution Hopf algebra over F (Frobenius–Hopf substrate). The depth-2 identification is:

\tau_{\mathrm{arch}}\!\bigl( G^{(2)}(\mathcal{H}_q) \big/ \mathcal{P}_1 \bigr)_F \cong K_3^{\mathrm{ind}}(F) \otimes \mathbb{Q},

where the right-hand side carries the Bloch–Suslin regulator K_3^{\mathrm{ind}}(F) \otimes \mathbb{Q} \to \mathbb{R} / \pi^2 \mathbb{Q}. This identification is a theorem, with proof chain via the Bloch group \mathfrak{B}(F), Suslin's isomorphism, and the archimedean evaluation of \mathrm{Li}_2^q.

Combined with prop:borel-partial-resolution, depth 2 of conj:gb-depth-period-correspondence is a theorem over every Bring-natural number field F = \mathbb{Q}(z_K). Depth 3 is conditional on Goncharov's motivic conjecture but has all non-Goncharov steps provable. Depth \geq 4 is conditional on Beilinson and Goncharov.
